_comment: Human adjudication of the benign-slice HIGH/CRITICAL findings. run.py deliberately does NOT write this: the false-positive rate is a human judgement, and a harness that labelled its own findings would be measuring nothing. Verdict rule (see triage.md): rate = false_positive / adjudicated; ambiguous counts in the denominator only.
tuned_note: Post-fix re-measurement. The scanner-attributable false positives (X-Velarion-Agent-Token, X-SignDocs-Client-Secret) are cleared by extending the AAK-MCP-001 credential-header family to the -token/-secret suffixes. The remaining false positives are corpus-attributable: fetch_registry._to_config() converted remotes[0] only, and the committed manifest predates that fix, so they clear on the next 'make corpus' refresh rather than now. The untuned 4/6 is recorded in triage.md and in the RESULTS.md history table.
